# Syntyr CSS

> MIT-licensed CSS-first interface system for accessible SaaS, business, and futuristic interfaces. No required JavaScript, build tool, or runtime dependencies. Read release boundaries before generating markup.

The **published immutable release** is v0.3.0-alpha.4 (Grid, Noir, Studio). The main branch currently represents an **unreleased v0.3.0-alpha.5 candidate** with additional themes and modules. Documentation follows current source unless it explicitly refers to the published tag; verify availability against the version you actually install.

## Choose the right representation

For browser readers, use the [human-readable HTML documentation directory](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/reference.html) and [practical HTML guides](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/guides.html). For retrieval by coding agents, most technical-guide links below point to public Markdown sources with the same guide content. The design resources directory is a standalone HTML page. All are served directly without user-agent spoofing or a JavaScript requirement.

## Start here

- [Published v0.3.0-alpha.4 documentation](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/v/0.3.0-alpha.4/llms.txt): Verified published CSS modules and themes; prefer this when using alpha.4.

- [Frameworks index](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/llms-frameworks.txt): Topic-specific framework and platform integration reference.
- [Canonical DESIGN.md contract](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/DESIGN.md)

- [Complete curated reference](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/llms-full.txt)
- [Syntyr Pro concept](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/pro): Proposed SaaS/CRM/operations templates. The public research page includes one authentic static screenshot (docs/previews/pro-work-orders-studio.webp) from fictional work-order sample data, not an interactive preview. Private candidate, not for sale; no premium source, license grant, payment or customer download is available.
- [Syntyr Studio concept](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/studio): Proposed website and application templates. The public research page includes one authentic static screenshot (docs/previews/studio-saas-home.webp) from a fictional B2B SaaS homepage, not an interactive demo. Private candidate, not for sale; no premium source, license grant, checkout or customer download is available.

- [Syntyr vs Tailwind vs plain CSS decision guide](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/tailwind-alternative.html)
- [Agreed design principles and conformance](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/design-principles.md)
- [Media & Entertainment recipes](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/media-entertainment.md)
- [Component reference](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/components.md): Canonical low-entropy standard component inventory, native HTML controls (including range/file/color, datalist/optgroup and named disclosure examples), CSS classes, semantic-mode boundaries and candidate-only table wrapping migration. Unreleased layout customization includes optional `--syn-shell-max` (72rem), `--syn-shell-inline-inset` (2rem total), `--syn-header-gap` (1rem), `--syn-header-padding-block` (2rem), `--syn-nav-gap` (1rem) without changing existing defaults.
- [Component manifest](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/metadata/components.json)
- [Static Syntyr visual page builder](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/page-builder-guide.md)
- [Copy-owned HTML blocks and local registry adoption](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/blocks-guide.md): 85 copy-owned blocks covering common SaaS application screens and business website sections, including scrollable card rails, bento features, split product showcases, customer stories, pricing comparisons, signup, resource management, team invitations, billing, integrations and API/webhook settings; dependency-aware offline installer with verified hashes (unreleased alpha.5 candidate).
- [Native form-state contracts example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/form-state-contracts.html)
- [Native business workflow example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/native-workflows.html)
- [Task-based HTML How-To guides](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/how-to.html)
- [Interactive component playground](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/playground.html)
- [Portable component gallery manifest](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/metadata/component-gallery.v1.json): Generated examples with curated use cases, CSS-module requirements, catalog links, and native interaction/fallback metadata (unreleased alpha.5).
- [WordPress](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/wordpress.md), [Shopify](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/shopify.md), [Wix](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/wix.md), [Webflow](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/webflow.md), [Framer](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/framer.md)

## Reference

- [Distribution and pinned CSS](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/distribution.md): Self-hosting, pinned asset URLs, and a downloadable offline SaaS demo in the **unreleased alpha.5** ZIP candidate (not in published alpha.4).
- [Cloudflare hosting and cache contract](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/cloudflare-hosting.md)
- [Experimental Nulang Cloud hosting adapter](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/nulang-cloud-hosting.md)
- [Release freeze and exact-commit approval procedure](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/release-freeze.md): Maintainer-only human approval and evidence gates before freezing the unreleased alpha.5 candidate; technical preflight is not release authorization.
- [Optional npm package tarball audit](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/package-managers.md): Before any separately authorized npm publication, maintainers run `python3 scripts/audit_npm_package.py` to verify the actual archive, source bytes, exports, and allowlisted contents; this does not publish or approve alpha.5.
- [Public API stability](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/api-stability.md): Compatibility and release boundary, including a proposed minimum v1 contract (not yet approved); alpha.5 remains experimental.
- [Optional framework-neutral copy interaction](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/clipboard.md)
- [Optional symbols and icon motion](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/symbols.md)
- [Optional native animation companion](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/animation.md): Opt-in CSS-only website fade/slide/zoom effects, seamless two-row opposite-direction logo marquee with speed controls and static lists on focus, finite/infinite loop controls, CSS-only scroll effects, parallax and hover zoom, plus separate Web Animations API, repeat, stagger, viewport helpers and single-cycle dismissal example with reduced-motion support; **unreleased alpha.5**, never required by CSS core.
- [Composition recipes](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/recipes.md)
- [Five native application screens](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/app-screens.md)
- [Filter and record review example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/query-review.html)
- [Opt-in data-grid presentation](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/data-grid.md)
- [Machine-readable composition recipe contracts](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/editor-integration.md)
- [Figma component kit and source-derived handoff](https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/blob/main/docs/figma-component-kit.md)
- [Collection workspace and form-recovery example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/resource-workspace.html)
- [Runnable Go resource workbench](https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/tree/main/examples/go-resource-workbench)
- [Permission matrix enterprise example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/permission-matrix.html)
- [Workflow operations example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/workflow-operations.html)

- [Optional Vertigo admin integration guide](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/vertigo-integration.md): Optional MIT Syntyr styling for Vertigo. The static public preview has no backend; separate private local PostGIS and authenticated-tenant development evidence is not a shipped plugin, hosted demo, or paid product.
- [Premium CSS-only compositions and browser validation](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/premium-compositions.md)
- [Copyable form recipes](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/component-recipes.md)
- [Syntyr Form Customizer](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/form-builder.html): Build and preview native forms in the documentation editor, which uses JavaScript. Export copyable form markup or standalone HTML that requires no JavaScript.
- [Semantic HTML and native workflow recipes](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/semantic-components.md)
- [Native dropdowns and selects](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/dropdowns.md)
- [Native patterns and component imports](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/native-patterns.md): Five native interaction recipes (accordion, GET search, dialog, datalist, meter/output), progressive CSS-only carousel buttons/markers, and individual CSS entrypoints; unreleased alpha.5 source.

- [Live HTMX component playground](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/htmx-playground.html): Read-only Cloudflare Functions demo; self-hosted HTMX is docs-only, not a Syntyr core dependency.

## Commercial research (not for sale)

- [Syntyr Console Kit concept](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/console-kit.html): Separately authored, eight-screen private prototype with static screenshot previews and fictional data. **Not for sale:** no checkout, preorder, binding commercial license or working backend. The page offers a private preview request through the visitor's email app and a separate integration quote inquiry; neither is an order. All existing CSS, themes, components and public examples remain MIT licensed. Do not publish or claim access to the private kit source.
- [Product and proposed pricing overview](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/products.html): MIT core availability and not-for-sale premium concepts only. Includes Pro (application workflows) versus Studio (separately authored multi-page website templates) selection guidance and optional private research inquiries; these open the visitor’s email app and are neither sales nor preorders. The Studio theme in the MIT core remains free.
- [Commercial product metadata](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/metadata/commercial-offers.json)

## Assets

- [Pinned v0.3.0-alpha.4 core stylesheet](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/v/0.3.0-alpha.4/syntyr.core.css)
- [Expanded 49-example native HTML component catalog](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/catalog.html): Category-filtered copyable examples for typography, forms, navigation, data tables, media, semantic content and interactive HTML, including optional recipes, geometry and visualization modules (unreleased alpha.5 source candidate; load the indicated CSS module for each example).
- [Current experimental component gallery](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/)

- [Intrinsic layout cookbook and adoption](docs/composition-adoption.md) — CSS-only fluid spacing tokens, stacks, wrapping clusters, sidecars, responsive grids, and optional card switchers, with copyable HTML (unreleased alpha.5).

- [Syntyr CSS Blog](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/blog/)

- Guided first-project starter wizard: https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/starter-wizard.html (docs-only optional JavaScript; published alpha.4 assets)
